svg.desc: SW FMEA (SWF rev 1.10): one occurrence by detection grid per element, 50 elements, 149 rated causes, AP H 134 (D 9–10 93, D 5–8 23, D 1–4 18). Dashed markers show the predicted rating of 38 causes whose actions record a revised rating; none is achieved.
svg.text: Figure 3-12 · SW FMEA — occurrence × detection, element by element
SWF rev 1.10 · BL-007 · draft · why each cause has its priority, and what the planned actions are predicted to change

149 rated causes on 50 elements · AP H 134, of which 93 at D 9–10, 23 at D 5–8, 18 at D 1–4. Each panel is one element: where its causes sit in the AP table, and where the actions with a predicted rating would move them.

AP M region / cause rated M
AP L region / cause rated L
predicted by an action's `revised` rating (not achieved, not verified)

Rows: occurrence O 10 (top) to 1; columns: detection D 1 to 10. Background = AP from the AIAG-VDA table (rating-tables §5) at the element's highest severity; a number in a marker counts causes at that O and D; the tag gives causes · AP H.

A cause far right (D 9–10) is high because no targeted test detects it; far up, because the code is likely to be wrong. AP values are those stored in the YAML (fmea_lint checks them against the table).
